text:
jamie: Manager asked to bump offer for Sophie (Sr. SWE) to $210k base — she's currently in L6 band 5. Manager wants exception. Also need to coordinate start date, candidate has a ~6-week notice.

marta: Got it. Can you paste the proposed comp breakdown? We typically need manager justification + director signoff if it exceeds band cap. I'll prep the draft but will hold until approvals land.

jamie: Here are the numbers:
```
Base: $210,000
Equity: 0.4% (4-year, 1y cliff)
Signing: $15,000 one-time
Location: SF (remote ok)
Band: L6 band-5 (cap $195,000)
Justification: critical infra hire, on-call + cross-team ops, urgent impact
```

people-ops-bot: Approval workflow created: https://redwood.internal/approvals/req/8721 — routing: director -> finance -> HR. Estimated SLA: 48h. Submitter: jamie.

kumar: Thanks. Quick q: is that $210k base total comp or just base? Also need the hiring manager rationale in 2-3 bullets for the director. For start date, if notice is 6 weeks we'd be looking at ~May 12. Want to propose provisional start 2024-05-12 and allow earlier if candidate can negotiate with current employer.

jamie: Base is $210k (base only). Equity and signing as above. Manager bullets: 1) reduces single-point failure on infra subsystems, 2) has prior experience scaling KV-cache, 3) will lead critical resiliency sprint. Manager ok with provisional May 12; candidate said could try for May 5 if we push background/BG check.

sarah: Heads-up from finance: if base > band cap by >10% we require exec GC approval per comp policy. Also need cost center and headcount code to run budget impact. Payroll cutoff note: if we onboard before May 10 payroll cutoff, comp will be charged to Q2. I'll also check total OTE impact for annual forecast.

marta: Candidate doesn't need relocation. BG expected 3-5 business days once we submit. I'll tentatively block May 5 & May 12 on the calendar when I send the verbal. Should we include flexible start language in the verbal? e.g., "provisional start May 12, flexible to May 5 pending background".

kumar: :thumbsup: I'll escalate to the director now and include finance. Routing note: director -> VP People -> Finance if exec GC required. ETA 24-48h. Anyone object to offering provisional May 12 with flexibility?

jamie: No objections. Please cc hiring manager Diane and include manager justification. If director needs more data, I can add salary comps from market intel.

people-ops-bot: Approval update: Director approved (approval id 8721-D). Finance requested cost center info (reply to ticket). Next step: VP People review if exec GC required. Offer can be prepared as "contingent on background and final finance approval."

marta: I'll wait for cost center, then draft the formal offer and send verbal today. Thanks everyone — will follow up once finance posts the code.
